title: Drop saturating terms from the plan-conflict term set and cap the candidate list
action: Turn pcs-1 green. In packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/state_group/plan_conflicts.rs: (D1) change ONLY the term set — count_term_hits, conflict_candidates, the >=2 threshold and the rule-home half of derive_candidates stay exactly as they are. (D2) drop any term whose document frequency across the active decision store exceeds 3%. (D3) apply that cut ONLY when the store holds 200 or more active decisions; below the floor the behavior must be byte-identical to today, which is what keeps the existing small-fixture tests green. (D4) rank the resulting decision candidates by hit count and cap them at 50, and make a truncated list say so in its own output rather than truncating silently. derive_candidates already calls active_decisions(root, false) at line ~254 — thread that set into the term filter instead of loading it twice; change plan_terms's signature if that is the clean way. Put each constant next to a comment carrying its measured justification, the way PLAN_CELL_STATUSES and TERM_STOPWORDS already do: on this repo's live store (2589 active decisions, 31 terms) the >=2 rule yields 694 candidates and the 3% cut yields 36.
acceptance: pcs-1's test passes. Every pre-existing derive test passes unchanged. The scoring functions are untouched — git diff shows no edit to count_term_hits or conflict_candidates.
